arqui.title: ARQUI
arqui.subtitle: Guide field work using the project context that is available.
arqui.guidance_empty: No field evidence has been recorded for this project yet.
arqui.guidance_available: {{count}} evidence records are available in the project.
arqui.guidance_basis: Basis: structured project state, Evidence, HumanReview and SpatialRegistration.
arqui.guidance_alternatives: There are {{count}} alternatives available to explore.
arqui.basis_review: Because {{count}} AI_PROPOSED items remain pending human review.
arqui.basis_alternatives: Because the project exposes {{count}} available alternatives.
arqui.dialogue_placeholder: What would you like to know?
arqui.dialogue_pending: There are {{count}} AI_PROPOSED observations pending review.
arqui.dialogue_registration_yes: Yes, a spatial registration is available.
arqui.dialogue_registration_no: No spatial registration is available in the current context.
arqui.dialogue_known: There are {{photos}} photographs and {{confirmed}} confirmed observations.
arqui.dialogue_action_context: You can inspect the project context and location.
arqui.dialogue_navigate_alternatives: You can view and compare alternatives.
arqui.dialogue_knowledge_deferred: This is a general knowledge question. ARQUI will consult the Design Knowledge Agent while keeping it separate from project facts.
arqui.dialogue_unknown: I do not have enough information to answer without inventing a fact.
arqui.dialogue_knowledge_result: The Design Knowledge Agent returned {{count}} traceable matches.
arqui.diagnostic_pending_review: {{count}} AI_PROPOSED observations are pending human review.
arqui.diagnostic_compare_blocked: I cannot start comparison: {{count}} alternative is available and at least two are required.
arqui.diagnostic_no_blocking: I detect no blocking issues within the available checks.
arqui.consequence_compare: Comparison cannot start with one alternative.
arqui.consequence_registration: AR view may require a valid registration.
arqui.capability_missing_alternative: At least two alternatives are not available.
arqui.capability_discovery: SiMS-DeI supports comparison, registered AR, visual analysis and field capture. Readiness depends on current project state.
arqui.visual_analysis_available: A selected photo is available for the existing visual analysis flow. The result remains AI_PROPOSED until human review.
arqui.visual_analysis_missing_photo: I need a selected image to run visual analysis.
arqui.requirement_comparison: Comparison requires at least two alternatives; currently there are {{count}}.
arqui.requirement_known: The known requirements for this capability are available from its existing contract.
arqui.readiness_ready_comparison: Yes. Comparison is ready under the known prerequisites.
arqui.readiness_blocked_comparison: Comparison is blocked because at least two alternatives are required and there are {{count}}.
arqui.workflow_clarify: Do you want to study the site, review evidence, compare alternatives, or prepare AR?
arqui.workflow_goal_identified: Goal identified: {{goal}}. This is guidance; you decide each action.
arqui.workflow_based_on: Based on the explicit goal and current capability state.
arqui.workflow_review_visual: Review visual proposals with human authority
arqui.workflow_compare_alternatives: Compare alternatives without selecting a winner
arqui.workflow_registered_ar: Review spatial registration before AR visualization
arqui.reasoning_unknown: What we still do not know
arqui.reasoning_no_decision: This explanation does not create a recommendation, winner or decision.
arqui.capability_answer: Yes. {name} exists in SiMS-DeI; its current project readiness and limits are shown below.
arqui.capability_catalog_answer: I can identify {count} relevant implemented capabilities for this project. Ask about a photo, comparison, site, AR, operations or review.
arqui.capability_requirements_answer: {name} requires: {requirements}. I will not add requirements that are not part of its verified contract.
arqui.capability_workflow_answer: The shortest existing workflow for {name} is through the {destination} workspace. I can explain or open it, but I do not execute a general multi-step plan automatically.
arqui.capability_execution_available: This capability has a verified current execution path, subject to its existing controls.
arqui.capability_execution_not_authorized: I know how this capability is used, but general ARQUI execution authority is not authorized. I can prepare the inputs and open the existing action.
arqui.capability_unknown_answer: I cannot verify a capability for that request from the current project and implementation state.
arqui.limit_comparison_does_not_select_a_winne: Comparison does not select a winner
arqui.limit_general_knowledge_is_not_project_f: General knowledge is not project fact
arqui.limit_real_device_site_alignment_may_rem: Real device/site alignment may remain unproven
arqui.limit_arqui_does_not_confirm_on_behalf_o: ARQUI cannot confirm on behalf of the architect
arqui.limit_arqui_does_not_execute_operations_: ARQUI does not execute operations automatically
arqui.limit_expected_effect_is_not_observed_ef: Expected effect is not observed effect
arqui.p9_description: Prepare an action, preserve human authority, and verify the result.
arqui.p9_placeholder: E.g. change alternative A to 5 floors, or type “do it”
arqui.p9_prepared_detail: Change {alternative} to {floors} floors through the existing canonical operation.
arqui.p9_prepared: Action prepared for {alternative}: {floors} floors. Review and press Apply.
arqui.p9_false_success: The response arrived, but readback did not verify the change.
arqui.p9_failed: The operation failed. No alternative mutation was attempted.
arqui.p9_stopped: Stopped. Delegation and prepared action were revoked.
arqui.p9_unsupported: Operation is not supported by the current capability.
arqui.p9_invalid: Invalid input; no mutation was performed.
arqui.p9_no_prepared: There is no current prepared action.
arqui.p9_delegation_started: Delegation active only for floor values you provide.
arqui.p9_scope: Current scope: {count} alternatives; no decision, winner, or automatic review.
arqui.problem_sections_value: Project {{project}} · site {{site}} · users {{users}} · program {{program}} · objectives {{objectives}} · constraints {{constraints}} · preferences {{preferences}}
arqui.problem_intent_missing: There is not enough basis to derive intent yet.
arqui.problem_no_generation: This view explains the problem; it does not generate alternatives or mutate geometry.
arqui.problem_answer_designing: We are designing {{project}} at the {{scope}} scale.
arqui.problem_answer_unknown: There are {{count}} unknown or clarification items.
arqui.problem_answer_tensions: {{count}} tensions were identified; none has an automatic winner.
arqui.problem_answer_blocking: There are {{count}} blockers for bounded exploration.
arqui.problem_answer_summary: The problem contains {{questions}} questions and its readiness is {{readiness}}.
arqui.synthesis_subtitle: Drivers, strategies and parti hypotheses derived from the current design problem.
arqui.synthesis_no_winner: No strategy is a winner. Human review is required.
arqui.synthesis_no_generation: Hypotheses only; no geometry, decision or recommendation was created.
arqui.synthesis_summary: The synthesis contains {{count}} coherent strategy hypotheses.
arqui.synthesis_trace_answer: Each strategy is traced to the design problem and its drivers; no autonomous causality is claimed.
arqui.synthesis_tradeoff_answer: Each strategy exposes expected trade-offs and unresolved unknowns for human review.
arqui.synthesis_empty: No synthesis can be derived until the project problem has sufficient identity and context.
arqui.synthesis_no_decision: No winner, recommendation or decision is created.
arqui.a14_description: Translate A11/A12/A13 intent into an existing canonical geometric operation, with readback.
arqui.a14_no_silent_degradation: Unsupported elements remain visible; no silent substitution is made.
arqui.a14_preview_ready: Preview prepared; no geometry was mutated.
arqui.a14_preview_boundary: Review the predicted effect before authorizing execution.
arqui.a14_unknown_preservation: Preservation could not be verified from the available state.
arqui.a14_false_success: False-success protection: execution response did not match readback.
arqui.a14_geometry_verified: Canonical geometry changed and readback verified the result.
arqui.a14_no_decision: A14 does not create a winner, recommendation or decision.
